HOW IT NAVIGATES WITHOUT GPSكيف يعمل دون GPS
01Pre-load the map

Satellite tiles of the operating area are loaded before take-off.

02Two solutions in parallel

GPS-aided INS and pure INS run side by side the whole flight.

03Learn the drift

An ML model learns this airframe's bias, temperature and vibration signature.

04Automatic handover

On GPS loss, the learned correction plus camera map fixes take over. No operator action.

SYSTEM ARCHITECTUREمعمارية النظام
LAYER 1Sensing

Stereo pair · Sony IMX477 nadir camera · FLIR Lepton 3.5 · ADIS16470 IMU · u-blox ZED-F9P

raw sensor streams
LAYER 2 · OUTER NAV LOOPNVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 8 GB

Satellite map matching (OpenCV) · YOLOv8-n landmarks, INT8 on DLA · ORB-SLAM3 VIO on GPU · INS drift-learning model

MAVLink 2 · message signing · AES-256
LAYER 3 · INNER FLIGHT LOOPCubePilot Cube Orange+

Unmodified ArduPilot · EKF3 covariance-weighted fusion · PID attitude · L1 guidance

control surface and propulsion commands
LAYER 4Host airframe

Any fixed-wing UAV with a MAVLink autopilot. Remove the pod and it flies exactly as before.

Nothing safety-critical moved into new software. ApexNav only supplies a better position estimate.
